title.value: NOx emissions prediction for MSWI process based on dynamic modular neural network
title.justification: The title explicitly states the focus of the study, which is the prediction of NOx emissions using a dynamic modular neural network in the municipal solid waste incineration process.
title.quote: NOx emissions prediction for MSWI process based on dynamic modular neural network

analysis.description: The paper proposes a dynamic modular neural network (DMNN) for predicting NOx emissions in municipal solid waste incineration (MSWI) processes. The study involves a principal component analysis (PCA)-based dynamic task decomposition method and the design of an adaptive long short-term memory (ALSTM) network. The DMNN is tested on benchmark and real industrial data to demonstrate its effectiveness in industrial applications.

type.justification: The study involves experiments on benchmark and real industrial data to showcase the effectiveness of the proposed DMNN model, indicating an empirical approach.
type.quote: Finally, the merits of proposed DMNN are confirmed on a benchmark and real industrial data of a MSWI process.
